title: Vast header
description: A fixed 80px navigation: over the opening photo it is transparent with white text (logo, four links, a quiet link and a white button); once you scroll it becomes a white bar inset 28px from the window edges with dark text and a dark button, slides up out of view while you scroll down past the first screen and comes back when you scroll up. Link hover fills a pill behind the text over 0.5s. On phones it is a full-width bar with a two-line menu button that opens a panel of links.
notes: made for sitting over a full-bleed photo: the transparent state uses white text (highlight-foreground)
position fixed: it overlays the first block, so give that block its own top room (the hero does)
scroll behaviour needs JavaScript; with reduced motion the bar still changes state but doesn't animate
